Description SONOFF Fusion Series 1-Gang Wall Switch Enclosure | E1GSL is the official no-neutral-wire version of the SONOFF Fusion Series 1-gang wall switch enclosure. SONOFF designed E1GSL specifically for the SONOFF ZBMINIL2 in-wall retrofit module, helping installers fit a smart switch solution into standard wall boxes with a cleaner finished look. Official SONOFF information highlights a PC material housing, a clip-on installation design, a micro-arc button structure, and an ultra-slim enclosure body under 23 mm. SONOFF also states that E1GSL fits both 86-type mounting boxes and European round mounting boxes with 60 mm diameter. Features Official E1GSL no-neutral-wire wall switch enclosure for SONOFF ZBMINIL2 retrofit projects. Compatible with SONOFF ZBMINIL2 for smart wall-switch control where no neutral wire is available. PC material construction that SONOFF describes as fire-resistant, scratch-resistant, and durable. Clip-on installation design that simplifies wiring and reduces installation complexity. Micro-arc button design for smoother pressing feel and cleaner wall-switch appearance. Ultra-slim enclosure profile for shallower wall-box installations and retrofit use.
